links.comparator_used: Other temperature settings across nine levels (0.00 to 2.00) for GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, with no vendor default arm reported
links.outcome: Correctly formatted predictions and other performance metrics for extracting the number of randomized participants and classifying abstracts as RCT and/or oncology-related
links.effect: Both models gave correctly formatted predictions for more than 98.7% of abstracts at temperatures 0.00 to 1.50. Formatted predictions then declined, with the most notable drop between 1.75 and 2.00. Other performance metrics remained largely stable.
links.quote: Temperature settings at or below 1.50 yielded consistent performance across text mining tasks, with performance declines at higher settings.
